edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $[●], payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding and deductions. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated executives, subject to the terms of those plans. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s annual bonus program, if any, with any bonus opportunity, performance criteria, and payment terms determined in accordance with the applicable plan or program documents.
edits.name: Compensation

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, or if the Executive resigns for Good Reason, then, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims, the Executive shall receive: (a) severance payments equal to twelve months of the Executive’s then-current base salary, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices; (b) payment or reimbursement of COBRA premiums for the Executive and eligible dependents for up to twelve months, or until the Executive becomes eligible for comparable coverage from another employer, if earlier; and (c) any earned but unpaid annual bonus for a completed performance period, plus a prorated target annual bonus for the year of termination, based on the number of days employed during that year. The severance benefits in this Section shall also apply if, within twelve months following a Change in Control, the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason. For purposes of this Agreement, “Good Reason” means a material reduction in base salary, a material diminution in duties or authority, a required relocation of more than fifty miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company, in each case after written notice from the Executive within thirty days of the event, a thirty-day cure period, and resignation within thirty days after the cure period expires if the condition is not cured.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. During employment and for twelve months after departure, the Executive shall not, to the extent permitted by applicable law and only as reasonably necessary to protect the Company’s legitimate business interests, provide services to a Named Competitor in a Restricted Capacity within the Restricted Territory. For purposes of this Section: (a) “Named Competitor” means the competitors identified on Schedule A; (b) “Restricted Capacity” means a role or function involving business lines, products, services, or strategic initiatives in which the Executive had material involvement during the twelve months preceding the Executive’s termination of employment; and (c) “Restricted Territory” means the territories identified on Schedule A in which the Company conducted material business and as to which the Executive had material responsibility or access to material confidential information during the twelve months preceding termination. This Section shall not prohibit passive ownership of less than two percent of the outstanding securities of a publicly traded company.
edits.name: Non-Compete
